groups.label: Surfaces
groups.description: The backgrounds everything sits on, from the page to raised panels.

groups.label: Text
groups.description: Foreground colours for prose, labels and anything drawn on the accent.

groups.label: Accent
groups.description: The brand and action colours: links, active states, filled buttons.

groups.label: Brand marks
groups.description: The Lucidos tile, the Claude logo and the Codex logo, on the chat's actor chips and wherever else they draw in their own colours. They keep their brand colours until a theme sets them.

groups.label: Status
groups.description: Colours that carry meaning: success, caution, error, and neutral notable state.

groups.label: Header
groups.description: The bar across the top of every pane: its fill, its foreground, badges and control veils.

groups.label: Focus
groups.description: How Lucidos shows where you are: the focused pane's header, the mobile pane dot, the navigation spotlight and the keyboard focus ring.

groups.label: Shape
groups.description: Corner radii of controls, surfaces, and circles and pills.

groups.label: Syntax
groups.description: Code highlighting in previews and tool output.

groups.label: Typography
groups.description: The code font. A theme suggests the UI font with `fonts.ui`, and the user's own font pick wins over it.

tokens.name: --bg-primary
tokens.label: Background
tokens.description: The page background. A seed: set it and the other surfaces, the text greys and the header follow.

tokens.name: --bg-secondary
tokens.label: Surface
tokens.description: Panels, cards and the default floating surface.

tokens.name: --bg-tertiary
tokens.label: Raised surface
tokens.description: Chips, question options and controls on a surface.

tokens.name: --bg-quaternary
tokens.label: Highest surface
tokens.description: The strongest fill, for pressed and nested controls.

tokens.name: --bg-hover
tokens.label: Hover
tokens.description: The fill a row or control takes under the pointer.

tokens.name: --bg-selected
tokens.label: Selected
tokens.description: The fill of the selected row.

tokens.name: --border-color
tokens.label: Border
tokens.description: Hairlines between rows and around surfaces.

tokens.name: --surface-bg
tokens.label: Floating surface
tokens.description: Toasts, menus, popovers and dialogs.

tokens.name: --picked-surface
tokens.label: Picked surface
tokens.description: The user's own message bubble and a chosen answer.

tokens.name: --scrim
tokens.label: Scrim
tokens.description: The dimming layer behind a blocking dialog.

tokens.name: --text-primary
tokens.label: Text
tokens.description: Body text. A seed: set it and the secondary and muted greys follow.

tokens.name: --text-secondary
tokens.label: Secondary text
tokens.description: Labels and supporting text.

tokens.name: --text-muted
tokens.label: Muted text
tokens.description: Hints, timestamps and placeholders.

tokens.name: --text-on-accent
tokens.label: Text on accent
tokens.description: Labels on filled accent buttons and badges.

tokens.name: --text-strong
tokens.label: Strong text
tokens.description: Bold text, where the UI font has no bold face and draws bold with its regular strokes. A step brighter than the text by default.

tokens.name: --text-glow
tokens.label: Text glow
tokens.description: Kept for themes written before parts: the text-shadow of the chat-text, actor-label, header-title and composer-text parts. None by default.

tokens.name: --accent
tokens.label: Accent
tokens.description: Links, active states and highlights. A seed: set it and the action colour, the header tint and the focus cues follow.

tokens.name: --accent-light
tokens.label: Light accent
tokens.description: A lighter step of the accent, for hover and emphasis.

tokens.name: --accent-action
tokens.label: Action
tokens.description: The fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: --brand-blue
tokens.label: Brand blue
tokens.description: The Lucidos brand blue, behind the default action colour and light header.

tokens.name: --brand-blue-deep
tokens.label: Deep brand blue
tokens.description: The deeper brand blue, the light header's lower stop and the header badge text.

tokens.name: --initiator-coding-agent
tokens.label: Coding agent
tokens.description: The coding-agent brand orange. The Claude mark takes it unless a theme sets --claude-mark.

tokens.name: --lucidos-mark-bg-top
tokens.label: Lucidos tile, top
tokens.description: The Lucidos tile's gradient at its upper-left light source.

tokens.name: --lucidos-mark-bg-bottom
tokens.label: Lucidos tile, bottom
tokens.description: The Lucidos tile's gradient at the far corner. Set both stops to one colour for a flat tile.

tokens.name: --lucidos-mark-fg
tokens.label: Lucidos glyph
tokens.description: The three squares and the spark on the Lucidos tile.

tokens.name: --claude-mark
tokens.label: Claude mark
tokens.description: The Claude logo on the chat's actor chips and in navigation history. Follows --initiator-coding-agent by default.

tokens.name: --codex-mark
tokens.label: Codex mark
tokens.description: The Codex logo's stroke. Follows the light accent by default.

tokens.name: --accent-green
tokens.label: Success
tokens.description: Success, applied, confirm.

tokens.name: --accent-green-soft
tokens.label: Success word
tokens.description: A status word in a pill, such as Installed or applied: the success green pulled toward secondary text.

tokens.name: --accent-yellow
tokens.label: Caution
tokens.description: Caution only. Never a neutral marker.

tokens.name: --accent-red
tokens.label: Error
tokens.description: Errors and destructive actions.

tokens.name: --accent-orange
tokens.label: Orange
tokens.description: A warm step between caution and error.

tokens.name: --accent-notable
tokens.label: Notable
tokens.description: A neutral state worth marking that is not a caution: waiting, trimmed, changed.

tokens.name: --header-bar-top
tokens.label: Header top
tokens.description: The header gradient's top stop. The macOS title-bar band takes it too.

tokens.name: --header-bar-bottom
tokens.label: Header bottom
tokens.description: The header gradient's bottom stop.

tokens.name: --header-gradient
tokens.label: Header fill
tokens.description: The header's whole fill. Built from the two stops by default; set it to a flat colour for a flat bar.

tokens.name: --titlebar-strip-bg
tokens.label: Title-bar band
tokens.description: The reclaimed macOS title-bar band above the header.

tokens.name: --titlebar-strip-continues
tokens.label: Title-bar band continues header
tokens.description: 1 paints the header fill up through the macOS title-bar band, lined up with the header. 0 keeps the band solid.

tokens.name: --header-fg
tokens.label: Header text
tokens.description: Every glyph and label on the header.

tokens.name: --header-fg-muted-alpha
tokens.label: Header muted strength
tokens.description: How strong muted header glyphs are, from 0 to 1.

tokens.name: --header-fg-muted
tokens.label: Header muted text
tokens.description: Muted header glyphs. Built from the header text and its strength by default.

tokens.name: --header-control-veil-hover
tokens.label: Control hover veil
tokens.description: How much header text colour a control mixes in under the pointer.

tokens.name: --header-control-veil-active
tokens.label: Control on veil
tokens.description: The veil of a header control that is toggled on.

tokens.name: --header-control-veil-active-hover
tokens.label: Control on, hover veil
tokens.description: The veil of a toggled-on control under the pointer.

tokens.name: --header-divider
tokens.label: Header divider
tokens.description: The line between pane headers. Transparent by default, for one seamless bar.

tokens.name: --header-badge-bg
tokens.label: Header badge
tokens.description: The fill of a count badge on the header.

tokens.name: --header-badge-fg
tokens.label: Header badge text
tokens.description: The text of a count badge on the header.

tokens.name: --focus-header-tint
tokens.label: Focused header wash
tokens.description: The wash over the focused pane's header segment. Set it transparent to turn the wash off.

tokens.name: --focus-header-underline
tokens.label: Focused header underline
tokens.description: A line under the focused pane's header segment. Transparent (off) by default.

tokens.name: --focus-header-underline-width
tokens.label: Underline width
tokens.description: The thickness of the focused header underline, in px.

tokens.name: --focus-pill-bg
tokens.label: Mobile pane dot
tokens.description: The active pane dot on the phone header.

tokens.name: --focus-pill-glow
tokens.label: Mobile pane dot glow
tokens.description: The bloom around the active pane dot.

tokens.name: --nav-focus-glow
tokens.label: Navigation spotlight
tokens.description: The neutral spotlight on the item you navigated to. Keep it hue-free: it marks a place, not a state.

tokens.name: --nav-focus-border-alpha
tokens.label: Spotlight border
tokens.description: How strong the spotlight's hairline border is.

tokens.name: --focus-ring
tokens.label: Keyboard focus ring
tokens.description: The ring around the control that has keyboard focus.

tokens.name: --radius-control
tokens.label: Control radius
tokens.description: Corner radius of buttons, inputs and rows.

tokens.name: --radius-surface
tokens.label: Surface radius
tokens.description: Corner radius of toasts, menus, popovers and dialogs.

tokens.name: --radius-round
tokens.label: Round radius
tokens.description: Corner radius of circles and pills: round buttons, dots and chips. Set it to 0 to square them. Badges on icons stay round in every theme.

tokens.name: --shadow-sm
tokens.label: Small shadow
tokens.description: Low elevation.

tokens.name: --shadow-md
tokens.label: Medium shadow
tokens.description: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: --shadow-lg
tokens.label: Large shadow
tokens.description: Dialogs.

tokens.name: --shadow-up
tokens.label: Upward shadow
tokens.description: A surface docked under the content it lifts off.

tokens.name: --syntax-key
tokens.label: Key
tokens.description: Code highlighting: keys.

tokens.name: --syntax-string
tokens.label: String
tokens.description: Code highlighting: strings.

tokens.name: --syntax-number
tokens.label: Number
tokens.description: Code highlighting: numbers.

tokens.name: --syntax-keyword
tokens.label: Keyword
tokens.description: Code highlighting: keywords.

tokens.name: --syntax-comment
tokens.label: Comment
tokens.description: Code highlighting: comments.

tokens.name: --syntax-control
tokens.label: Control flow
tokens.description: Code highlighting: control flows.

tokens.name: --syntax-type
tokens.label: Type
tokens.description: Code highlighting: types.

tokens.name: --syntax-function
tokens.label: Function
tokens.description: Code highlighting: functions.

tokens.name: --font-mono
tokens.label: Code font
tokens.description: The font for code, paths and tool output.
